sentences.text: Appellants/claimants have preferred this appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 calling in question the legality, validity and correctness of impugned award dated 21/11/2019 passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jashpur in Claim Case No. 08/2019 seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Learned counsel for the appellants/claimants would submit that appellants/claimants No. 1 and 2, being parents of the deceased, are entitled to get filial consortium of Rs. 44,000/- each, which has not been granted by the Claims Tribunal, as such, the amount of compensation may suitably be enhanced.
3.

Learned counsel for respondent No. 3 would support the impugned award and submit that the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal is just and proper and does not require any interference by this Court, as such, the instant appeal is liable to be dismissed.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties, considered their rival submissions made herein-above and went through the records with utmost circumspection.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having gone through the records, I am of the considered opinion that the appellants/claimants No. 1 and 2, being parents of the deceased, ought to have been granted Rs. 44,000/- each under the head of filial consortium, which has not been granted by the Claims Tribunal.

Accordingly, the appellants/claimants are held entitled to additional compensation amount of Rs. 88,000/- which will be paid by the respondent No. 3 within 30 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
The additional amount of compensation shall carry interest @ 8% per annum from the date of filing of claim application before the Tribunal i.e. 05/02/2019 till its realization.
Rest of the conditions of the impugned award shall remain intact.
6. Accordingly, the instant appeal is allowed to the extent indicated herein-above.
No cost(s).
